statusDefinitions.draft: The PDF exists in the directory but is awaiting content review and publication approval.
statusDefinitions.published: The PDF has passed content, source, accessibility, and publication checks.
statusDefinitions.outdated: The PDF may contain superseded information and must be reviewed before reuse.
statusDefinitions.archived: The PDF is retained for historical reference and is not an active admission guide.

contentStandards: Include only sections relevant to the course and admission pathway.
Explain eligibility and entrance examinations using applicable official sources.
Verify application and counselling dates before publication.
Identify the academic year covered by each guide.
Record the verification date for time-sensitive information.
Distinguish general guidance from official admission rules.
Explain when requirements differ by institution, state, counselling authority, or admission category.
Do not promise admission, seat allocation, scholarships, or employment.
Clearly state that official notifications and applicable regulations take precedence.
publishingChecklist: Confirm that the PDF exists and opens successfully.
Review the complete document for accuracy and completeness.
Confirm the academic year and applicable admission cycle.
Verify eligibility requirements against official sources.
Verify entrance examinations and counselling procedures.
Verify deadlines, fees, and payment periods where applicable.
Include official source URLs and a verification date.
Check PDF text extraction, hyperlinks, tables, and page layout.
Check accessibility, readable typography, and colour contrast.
Remove private or confidential information and metadata.
Confirm the deployed website URL resolves to the intended document.
Change the status to published only after all required checks pass.
Review or withdraw documents when official requirements change.

privacy.privateRecordsStorage: Use secure backend storage with appropriate authentication, authorization, and access controls.
